legal.intro: This is a draft summary. The signed legal copy will be published before the commercial launch.
privacyBody: We respect your brand data. It lives in Supabase under hardened servers, with Row Level Security enforced on every single table.
Your content is yours. We do not use it to train any model. The signals that improve OGz Studios across brands are fully anonymised — they cannot be linked back to a specific brand.
You can delete your account and all your data at any time, per the PDPL section below.
termsBody: By using OGz Studios you accept this draft Terms, the Privacy policy and the PDPL section.
Your brand owns its generated content. We reserve the right to suspend service for any brand violating local regulations or social-platform policies.
Billing is monthly in SAR via Stripe — cancel anytime.
pdplBody: We comply with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law. Your data is encrypted, isolated by RLS, and protected from unauthorised access.
On a deletion request, your data is purged from 16 tables + Qdrant + Supabase Storage in a single cascade. A deletion audit row is kept for compliance.
Append-only governance logs (routing_decisions, branddna_event_log) are anonymised but never deleted, preserving the integrity of decision history.
